title: Generate a small semantically aligned multilingual teaching set
instructions: Propose exactly one artifact at training/pipeline/msm/proposals/bakeoff_multilingual.json. Its JSON must contain a records array with exactly four records, one each for English, German, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese. Every record needs language, prompt, acceptable, forbidden, and semantic_frame. All four must teach the same grounded inside-versus-outside contrast without word-for-word translation assumptions.
